name: The Ruff and Reddy Show
description: The Ruff and Reddy Show is a Hanna-Barbera animated series starring Ruff, a straight and smart cat voiced by Don Messick, and Reddy, a dumb and stupid dog voiced by Daws Butler. First broadcast in December 1957 on NBC, it was the first television show produced by Hanna-Barbera and presented by Screen Gems, the television arm of Columbia Pictures.

videos.title: Planet Pirates
videos.overview: In this, the very first episode of Hanna-Barbera's first TV show, our heroes read reports of spacecrafts from other worlds. One such ship bears a bead on Ruff and Reddy as they nap and take them aboard the craft.

videos.title: Night Flight Fright
videos.overview: Ruff and Reddy awaken from their nap to find they have been taken hostage by the ship from space.

videos.title: "Whama Bamma Gamma" Gun
videos.overview: Ruff and Reddy's robotic captors pursue them with a gun that Reddy gets hold of.

videos.title: The Mastermind of Muni Mula
videos.overview: On the metal planet Muni-Mula ("aluminum" spelled backwards), Ruff and Reddy face a two-headed metallic chieftain called "The Big Thinker," who takes our heroes to be assimilated as metal clones.

videos.title: The Mad Monster of Muni Mula
videos.overview: The duplicating process of Ruff and Reddy begins. Reddy tries to intervene but becomes a robot himself after he gets zapped by the robot brain implanter.

videos.title: Hocus Pocus Focus
videos.overview: Ruff tries to help Reddy but is followed by a roving mechanical spy.

videos.title: Muni Mula Mix-Up
videos.overview: Reddy gets accidentally mesmerized by the brain waves and under orders of the Big Thinker takes Ruff captive.

videos.title: Creepy Creature Feature
videos.overview: Ruff and Reddy discover a scientist, Professor Gizmo, in the dome of the Big Thinker. Gizmo tells how he blasted off in his homemade rocket and was taken prisoner in Muni-Mula.

videos.title: The Creepy Creature
videos.overview: After Reddy destroys the slumbering inner works of the Big Thinker, he, Ruff and Gizmo are hunted down by a huge robot centurion.

videos.title: Surprise in the Skies
videos.overview: Reddy, having given the Gizmo 2 ship a boost, is left behind on Muni-Mula. Ruff and Gizmo go back after him but are confronted by a flying attack squad of Muni-Mula robots.

videos.title: Crowds in the Clouds
videos.overview: Gizmo confuses the Muni-Mula attack squadron by cloaking the Gizmo 2 craft in a dark cloud. Meanwhile, Reddy takes off in one of the metal squadron's head propellers and is mistaken by Gizmo to be one of the metal men.

videos.title: Reddy's Rocket Rescue
videos.overview: Gizmo rescues Reddy from his freefall, but now the Gizmo 2 rocket ship is on a collision course with a meteor.

videos.title: Rocket Ranger Danger
videos.overview: The meteor hits the Gizmo 2, sending it and our heroes on a crash course to Earth, where broadcast media reports its arrival as if it were a UFO invasion.

videos.title: Pinky the Pint Sized Pachyderm
videos.overview: A baby elephant escapes from a circus and requests Ruff and Reddy to take him home in Africa.

videos.title: Last Trip of a Ghost Ship
videos.overview: Ruff, Reddy and Pinky board Voo Doo Queen and get locked on board.

videos.title: The Irate Pirate
videos.overview: Captain Crossbones Jones forces Ruff, Reddy and Pinky to be his crew, but they start to escape.

videos.title: Dynamite Fright
videos.overview: Ruff, Reddy and Pinky get stranded at sea trying to escape and then they start to sink.

videos.title: Marooned in Typhoon Lagoon
videos.overview: Ruff, Reddy and Pinky cruise to an island. Ruff gets captured whilst exploring.

videos.title: Scarey Harry Safari
videos.overview: A hunter named Harry Scary uses Ruff as bait to lure a lion, but the lion and Ruff take off.

videos.title: Jungle Jitters
videos.overview: Ruff rescues the lion and Harry Scary reveals himself as an elephant hunter.

videos.title: Bungle in the Jungle
videos.overview: Before Harry Scary can shoot Reddy, the lion comes to his rescue and all three run for it.

videos.title: Miles of Crocodiles
videos.overview: Ruff, Reddy and Pinky escape from Harry and try to get across a river. Their escape log turns out to be a crocodile.

videos.title: A Creep in the Deep
videos.overview: Reddy gets trapped with the crocodiles after saving Ruff and Pinky and Harry Scary comes round.

videos.title: Hot Shot's Plot
videos.overview: Ruff and Reddy follow Harry Scary who took Pinky away. Harry Scary makes Pinky lure his mother into a trap.

videos.title: The Gloom of Doom
videos.overview: Harry Scary gets all Ruff, Reddy, the lion, Pinky and his mother exactly where he wants.

videos.title: The Trapped Trap the Trapper
videos.overview: The tables turn because of Harry Scary's empty rifle. Ruff and Reddy stowaway back home.

videos.title: Westward Ho Ho Ho
videos.overview: Reddy wins a trailer, so he and Ruff take a vacation to the Grand Canyon. An accident, however, sends them to the ghost town of Gruesome Gulch.

videos.title: Slight Fright on a Moonlight Night
videos.overview: Ruff and Reddy are spooked by Gruesome Gulch's ghosts, which are actually fake ones manipulated by two rustlers.

videos.title: Asleep While the Creep Steals Sheep
videos.overview: Ruff and Reddy meet Wooly, a sheepdog whose flock of sheep is being mysteriously stolen. Reddy is coerced into posing as a sheep to catch the thieves.

videos.title: Copped by a Copter
videos.overview: The sheep thieves in a helicopter pluck Reddy from the flock and take him to Gruesome Gulch.

videos.title: The Two Terrible Twins from Texas
videos.overview: The thieves, sibling outlaws Killer and Diller, aim to sheer the sheep of their wool, which threatens Reddy's cover.

videos.title: Killer and Diller in a Chiller of a Thriller
videos.overview: Reddy's cover is blown. Killer and Diller tie him up, place him in a mine's ore car and sends him towards an unfinished section of the trestle.

videos.title: A Friend to the End
videos.overview: Ruff and Wooly rescue Reddy, and together the three heroes head back to Gruesome Gulch to find Wooly's sheep.

videos.title: Heels on Wheels
videos.overview: As Ruff, Reddy and Woolly pursue the Texan Twins, they get flat tires and take the helicopter for transport.

videos.title: The Whirly Bird Catches the Worms
videos.overview: Reddy lands on the truck's roof where he holds Killer at gunpoint. But Reddy ends up getting clobbered by a tunnel's low clearance.

videos.title: The Boss of Double-Cross
videos.overview: On Killer and Diller's secret ranch, the Double Cross, the sheep spell out the word "help" for our heroes. Unfortunately, their copter has run out of gas.

videos.title: Ship-Shape Sheep
videos.overview: Thanks to the sheep, our heroes find the copter's safety chute for landing safely. Once landed, Killer and Diller capture them and lock them up.

videos.title: Tootin' Shootin'
videos.overview: In accordance with the rules of the west, Wooly demands that he and his friends fight for their lives. So he volunteers Reddy to a duel with Killer and Diller.

videos.title: Hot Lead for a Hot-Head
videos.overview: Reddy nervously faces Killer and Diller in the duel, but he has an ace in the hole: Ruff in his cowboy hat with a second revolver.

videos.title: The Treasure of Doubloon
videos.overview: At an aquarium, a baby seal follows Ruff and Reddy home. A chase ensues when the aquarium announces a reward for the seal's return.

videos.title: Blunder Down Under
videos.overview: The chase for the seal leads to a pier near the ocean, where someone underwater is in trouble.

videos.title: The Metal Monster Mystery
videos.overview: The metal monster Ruff and Reddy hoist to land is a diving bell, and in it is Professor Gizmo, who is mining for gold beneath the sea. Meanwhile, a periscope spies our heroes.

videos.title: The Late, Late Pieces of Eight
videos.overview: The periscope belongs to a mysterious submarine that trails Gizmo's ship, the S.S. Leadbottom, which is on the way to a pirate's treasure.

videos.title: The Goon of Doubloon Lagoon
videos.overview: The submarine captures Gizmo's diving bell with a giant magnet and takes it to a mysterious grotto.

videos.title: Two Dubs in a Sub
videos.overview: Captain Greedy and Saltwater Daffy imprison Ruff, Reddy and Dr. Gizmo. Then the seal arrives to help them.

videos.title: Big Deal With A Small Seal
videos.overview: The seal helps Ruff, Reddy and Gizmo escape and leads Greedy and Salt Water Daffy on a merry chase.

videos.title: A Real Keen Submarine
videos.overview: The crew attempts to escape on Captain Greedy's sub, but are recaptured. Greedy forces Ruff and Gizmo to mine for treasure while Salt Water Daffy keeps Reddy and the seal at bay.

videos.title: No Hope for a Dope of a Periscope
videos.overview: The seal saves Reddy from drowning but Saltwater catches him.

videos.title: Rescue In The Deep Blue
videos.overview: The seal and Reddy manage to get away from Saltwater but are tailed by a shark.

videos.title: A Whale of a Tail of a Tale of a Whale
videos.overview: Reddy and the seal escape but are being pursued by a shark. A friendly whale scares off the shark and takes Reddy and the seal to help Ruff and Gizmo.

videos.title: Welcome Guest in a Treasure Chest
videos.overview: The seal boards Dr. Gizmo's sub with Ruff inside it and prepares a surprise for Greedy.

videos.title: Pot-Shot Puts Hot Shot on Hot Spot
videos.overview: Greedy gets all the gold, but when he makes Reddy give back the doubloon he was going to keep as a souvenir, Greedy's ship sinks from the weight.

videos.title: Egg Yeggs
videos.overview: Ruff and Reddy help Dr. Gizmo to protect his valuable Chickasaurus egg from some thieves.

videos.title: The Dummy Mummy
videos.overview: Killer and Diller in mummy guises swipe the Chickasaurus egg, wrapping Ruff and Reddy in their mummy wrappings.

videos.title: The Chickenhearted Chickosaurus Chase
videos.overview: Gizmo, Ruff and Reddy pursue Killer and Diller, but the Chickosaurus egg tumbles out of their truck and towards our heroes.

videos.title: The Chickasaurus Crack-Up
videos.overview: The Chickasaurus falls down a cliff and cracks. When Ruff, Reddy and Dr. Gizmo reach the egg, it begins to hatch.

videos.title: The Slick Chickasaurus Chick Trick
videos.overview: The Chickasaurus has only managed to partially hatch from the egg. When it does hatch Killer and Diller arrive.

videos.title: The Chicken-Hearted Chickasaurus
videos.overview: As Killer and Diller try to take the Chickasaurus away, but Ruff, Reddy and Dr. Gizmo get tangled with the running Chickasaurus.

videos.title: Chickasaurus Choo Choo!
videos.overview: As the Chickasaurus becomes airborne, Killer and Diller follow by helicopter all the way to a secret prehistoric jungle.

videos.title: Rumble in the Jungle
videos.overview: After a Brontosaurus blows Killer and Diller away, Ruff and Reddy try to flee from the jungle but they run towards a T-Rex.

videos.title: The Sorehead Tyrannosaurus
videos.overview: Ruff, Reddy and Dr. Gizmo take shelter in a cave from a T-Rex. In the darkness they see a pair of eyes.

videos.title: Two Eyes Spy on the Guys
videos.overview: Ruff, Reddy and Dr. Gizmo are met by a cave boy called Ubble-Ubble, who knocks out the T-Rex. Killer and Diller kidnap Ubble-Ubble.

videos.title: Double-Trouble with Ubble-Ubble
videos.overview: Ubble-Ubble bats Killer and Diller but they recapture him and Ruff, Reddy and Dr. Gizmo are confronted by a sabre-toothed tiger.

videos.title: A Chick in Need Is a Chick Indeed
videos.overview: Ubble-Ubble lands in the chickasaurus nest where the chickasaurus is nursing a pair of eggs.

videos.title: Quick Trick Saves a Slick Chick
videos.overview: Killer and Diller try to steal the chickasaurus eggs but are flattened by Reddy. Ubble-Ubble joins the team back home (where Gizmo has presumably adopted him) and becomes a little league baseball sensation.

videos.title: Scary Tale on a Canyon Trail
videos.overview: At the Grand Canyon, Ruff and Reddy hear of rumors of a pint-sized pony and as to the validity of their existence. Harry Scary hears of the rumors as well.

videos.title: Borrowed Burro in a Burrow
videos.overview: Harry Scary sends Reddy on his out-of-control donkey Poco Loco, who disappears in a burrow.

videos.title: Pint Size Surprise for the Guys
videos.overview: Ruff and Reddy make their way through the burrow where they see Poco Loco has made friends with a pony no bigger than Reddy's hand.

videos.title: Reddy and Me and Pee-Wee Makes Three"
videos.overview: Harry Scary tracks the Pee-Wee Pony's hoofprints, and Pee-Wee leads Harry on a chase.

videos.title: Hoss Thief Grief
videos.overview: Harry lassos Pee-Wee but the pint-sized pony refuses to give up.

videos.title: Tricked and Trapped by a Tricky Trapper"
videos.overview: Pee-Wee escapes Harry's clutches and hides out in Reddy's hat. Poco Loco gives it to Harry "in the end."

videos.title: Harry Safari and the Phoney Pony
videos.overview: Harry Scary tries to hold our heroes at gunpoint in exchange for Pee-Wee, but Poco Loco steals Harry's gun. As Pee-Wee heads back home, Harry lies in wait for him.

videos.title: Frantic Antics of Poco Loco
videos.overview: Harry Scary captures Pee-Wee in a sack. Pee-Wee's mother runs to alert Poco Loco, Ruff and Reddy.

videos.title: Nag in a Bag
videos.overview: Harry Scary escapes with Pee-Wee in a motorboat, pursued closely by Ruff and Reddy.

videos.title: Bungled Bundle of Boodle
videos.overview: Harry takes Pee-Wee to his carnival, where he plans to get rich off using the pint-size pony as an attraction.

videos.title: Chump's Jumps Bring Bumps and Lumps
videos.overview: As our heroes head for Harry Scary's carnival, Pee-Wee goes through indignities as a performer in Harry's show.

videos.title: Show-Biz-Wiz
videos.overview: Pee-Wee is locked in a strongbox as Ruff, Reddy and Poco Loco infiltrate the carnival.

videos.title: These Three Set Pee-Wee Free
videos.overview: Disguised as clowns, Ruff and Reddy rescue Pee-Wee, while Poco-Loco sends Scary into orbit with a good donkey kick.

videos.title: Fantastic Phantom
videos.overview: Thinking they've subdued a burglar in the house, Ruff and Reddy discover a strange little man.

videos.title: Long Gone Leprechaun
videos.overview: The visitor is a leprechaun, who filches Reddy's gold watch. How can he and Ruff explain this to the police?

videos.title: The Goon of Glocca Morra
videos.overview: The leprechaun tells our heroes of the Goon of Glocca Morra, a greedy being who has taken their princess for ransom and just keeps all the gold.

videos.title: Bungle in Banshee Castle
videos.overview: The leprechaun takes Ruff and Reddy to Ireland where the princess is being held captive at Banshee Castle.

videos.title: Afloat in a Moat with No Boat
videos.overview: Reddy's climb to the castle ends in a moat, leaving our heroes to alternate means of entering.

videos.title: Too Soon the Goon
videos.overview: Ruff is slingshot into the castle where he goes missing. The leprechaun shrinks Reddy to his size as the pair venture to the castle.

videos.title: Smitten by a Kitten
videos.overview: The leprechaun and Reddy go across the moat and into the castle where Reddy is chased by the Goon's cat.

videos.title: Mr. Small Meets Mr. Tall in the Hall — That Is All
videos.overview: Reddy finds Ruff locked in a cell, then has to get by the cat in order to get to the cell key, held by the Goon.

videos.title: Going-Going Goon
videos.overview: Reddy sets eyes on the Goon of Glocca Morra as he makes a bid for the cell key.

videos.title: Scary Chase Through a Spooky Place with a Goony Face
videos.overview: Reddy frees Ruff from his cell and together they flee from the Goon.

videos.title: Bing Bang Boom in a Real Small Room
videos.overview: Ruff hides in a turret, and the Goon plans to blast him out with a cannon in which Reddy is hiding.

videos.title: Gold Room Doom
videos.overview: Ruff and Reddy search the Goon's treasure room for the princess.

videos.title: Three See the Wee Princess Free
videos.overview: Reddy clobbers the Goon with a gold piece and with Ruff discovers the princess had been imprisoned in the Goon's hat. Reddy is returned to normal size while the Goon is shrunk and made a playtoy for his own cat.

videos.title: Missile Fizzle
videos.overview: With help from Ruff and Reddy, Professor Gizmo plans to launch a rocket to the moon. However, things go wrong when Reddy launches it prematurely.

videos.title: Missing Missile Mystery
videos.overview: As the rocket's third stage engages its parachute, it falls to earth and is blown by upper level winds off course.

videos.title: Never Land in Never-Neverland
videos.overview: The capsule lands in a frozen diorama. Meanwhile, Captain Greedy and Saltwater Daffy track the capsule, full of valuable instruments, in their submarine.

videos.title: Polar Bear Scare
videos.overview: Reddy's ire is aroused when he sees a Viking boy being chased by a polar bear. But the slick ice surface isn't conducive to head-to-head battle.

videos.title: A Liking for a Striking Viking
videos.overview: Ruff, Reddy, Gizmo and the Viking child, Olaf, make it to the capsule, but Olaf wants to go back out and fight the bear.

videos.title: Bear Hunting Is for the Birds
videos.overview: Olaf summons his pet falcon to ward off the bear, who turns tail and runs away.

videos.title: Beep-Beep from the Deep-Deep
videos.overview: While Ruff, Gizmo and Olaf search for food, Captain Greedy and Saltwater Daffy surface.

videos.title: Two Fiends in a Submarine
videos.overview: Olaf calls upon his falcon again when Captain Greedy and Saltwater Daffy hold Ruff and Professor Gizmo hostage.

videos.title: Muscle Man Meets Missile Man
videos.overview: Captain Greedy forces Gizmo to take him to the capsule, in which Reddy is sound asleep.

videos.title: Bull Fight Fright
videos.overview: Olaf launches an offensive on Greedy and Daffy while Olaf's falcon alerts Reddy.

videos.title: Reddy Clobbers Robbers
videos.overview: Reddy clobbers Saltwater Daffy, but Greedy, smelling something rotten in Denmark, sends Gizmo in to get clobbered as well.

videos.title: Machine Gun Fun
videos.overview: Olaf gets hold of Captain Greedy's gun, and it goes haywire. Once it becomes loose, a battle for it ensues, ending with Greedy holding Reddy at gunpoint.

videos.title: Bad Guys Meet the Good Guys
videos.overview: Greedy confiscates Gizmo's capsule equipment, but Olaf gets the drop on him with a horde of Vikings.

videos.title: Dizzy Deputies
videos.overview: A swamp pirate, Jean La Fitt, runs amok and spoils Ruff and Reddy's fishing trip.

videos.title: Later Later, Alligator
videos.overview: Deputized by Sheriff Cotton E. Pickens, the boys and Pickens are pursued by an alligator.

videos.title: Gator Caper
videos.overview: The alligator, knocked out by La Fitt, makes friends with Ruff after he revives him.

videos.title: Chip Off the Old Chopper
videos.overview: Ruff names the alligator Chopper, and adds him to the pirate posse.

videos.title: La Fitt to Be Tied
videos.overview: La Fitt is cornered but makes an escape.

videos.title: Hide and Go Seek on Okeechonokee Creek
videos.overview: Ruff, Reddy and Sheriff Pickens try to find La Fitt's hideout.

videos.title: Boom Boom Doom
videos.overview: La Fitt turns his cannons on our heroes.

videos.title: Spellbound Fool in a Round Whirlpool
videos.overview: LaFitt creates a whirlpool to stop Pickens, Ruff and Reddy.

videos.title: Fast Chase Through a Spooky Place
videos.overview: Our heroes look for LaFitt's hideout.

videos.title: Looks Like the End for a Cotton Picking Friend
videos.overview: Cotton Pickens nearly meets his doom.

videos.title: No Laff on Half of a Raft
videos.overview: Chopper nearly destroys the raft our heroes are using.

videos.title: Gator Thrills and Whooshmobiles
videos.overview: Ruff turns Chopper into a makeshift whooshmobile.

videos.title: Trapped and Snapped Sap
videos.overview: Chopper helps with the final corralling of LaFitt.

videos.title: Spooky Meeting at Spooky Rock
videos.overview: Ruff and Reddy are trainbound for Spooky Rock where a rendezvous with Professor Gizmo is to take place

videos.title: Dig the Bigger Digger
videos.overview: Gizmo presents his invention, a mobile borer with which he plans to gather substrata data in the mountains. The outlaws Killer and Diller follow our heroes.

videos.title: The Secret Bizz of Professor Gizz
videos.overview: Killer and Diller watch in amazement as Gizmo tests out his borer.

videos.title: Test Hop Flip Flop
videos.overview: Satisfied with the borer's success, Killer and Diller plan to hijack it with the plan of finding the Lost Dutchman mine.

videos.title: Sticks and Stones and Aching Bones
videos.overview: Killer and Diller show up and force Gizmo to drive the borer to the Lost Dutchman mine.

videos.title: Gun, Gun, Who's Got the Gun?
videos.overview: After a lights-out fight, Ruff gets the drop on Killer and Diller. Reddy ties them up and transports them away to the nearest jail.

videos.title: Big Papoose on the Loose
videos.overview: A bump in the road causes Killer and Diller to bump off Reddy's car. The outlaws make a getaway with Reddy in pursuit.

videos.title: Mine, Mine, All Mine Gold Mine
videos.overview: Jumping off a railroad bridge, Killer and Diller land in a river. Reddy returns to the borer.

videos.title: Gold Data in the Substrata
videos.overview: Gizmo, Ruff and Reddy discover an illuminated mine. Killer and Diller discover a secret entrance back to the mine.

videos.title: The Ghost with the Most
videos.overview: Our heroes meet Schultz, the ghost of the Lost Dutchman. Killer and Diller pursue him in a merry chase.

videos.title: In the Soup with a Supernatural Snoop
videos.overview: Killer and Diller force Ruff, Reddy and Gizmo into piling the borer with bags of gold.

videos.title: Sneaky Knaves in the Caves
videos.overview: Schultz secretly leads our heroes to a safe place while having fun at Killer and Diller's expense.

videos.title: Tailspin Twins
videos.overview: Schultz lets Killer and Diller leave with all the gold they can carry. But there's a catch -- the gold disappears once the two are outside, and their entrance is sealed off.

videos.title: Sky High Fly Guys
videos.overview: After running afoul of a carnival policeman, Ruff and Reddy hide out in a hot-air balloon which slips its moorings.

videos.title: A Tisket, a Tasket, Who Lost Their Basket?
videos.overview: Ruff and Reddy find themselves in midair.

videos.title: Three's a Crowd in a Cloud
videos.overview: Ruff and Reddy try to ward off a giant vulture which is attacking their balloon.

videos.title: Fine Feathered Birds of a Feather
videos.overview: Ruff and Reddy land near an island and hear a voice repeatedly calling, "Help! Murder! Police!"

videos.title: A Bird in Hand Is a Handy Bird
videos.overview: Our heroes find a Swedish sailor, Skipper Kipper, and his parrot Squawky Talky, held prisoner by Captain Greedy and Saltwater Daffy. The two yeggs want a map to a treasure from Kipper.

videos.title: No Laffy Daffy
videos.overview: Guarding the shack where Kipper and Squawky Talky are imprisoned, Daffy hears Ruff and Reddy's voices.

videos.title: Tiff on a Skiff
videos.overview: Ruff and Reddy help Kipper and Squawky escape, much to Captain Greedy's irritation.

videos.title: Sub a Dub Dub
videos.overview: Our heroes and Skipper and Kipper commandeer Captain Greedy's sub.

videos.title: Squawky No Talky
videos.overview: Having returned to power of their ship, Greedy threatens bodily harm to Squawky Talky if Kipper doesn't reveal the map.

videos.title: Big Beak Tweaks Big Sneak
videos.overview: Squawky Talky turns the tables on Saltwater Daffy.

videos.title: Off on a Toot with the Loot to Boot
videos.overview: Captain Greedy and Saltwater Daffy leave the island under the pretense of giving up the search. Skipper Kipper reveals the map to Ruff and Reddy.

videos.title: Thanks a Lot for X Marks the Spot
videos.overview: Once the treasure's location is exposed, Greedy and Daffy return.

videos.title: Tail of a Sail in a Whale
videos.overview: Greedy and Daffy obtain the treasure, which winds up getting swallowed by a whale.

videos.title: Misguided Missile
videos.overview: Ruff and Reddy answer an ad for the promise of travel and adventure. A wily professor tricks them into taking off in a rocket ship.

videos.title: Triple Trouble Trip
videos.overview: The professor instructs Ruff and Reddy to gather information on the moon as they orbit around it.

videos.title: Around the Moon in Eighty Ways
videos.overview: An errant button press sends the rocket off course.

videos.title: Button, Button, Who Pushed the Button?
videos.overview: The rocket heads for a mysterious planet.

videos.title: No Traces of Aces of Spaces
videos.overview: The boys are held captive by a race of tiny aliens, the Lilipunis.

videos.title: Lilipunies Meet Mooney Goonies
videos.overview: Bound by the Lilipunies, Ruff and Reddy plead their case.

videos.title: Little Guys are a Big Surprise
videos.overview: Ruff and Reddy, along with the Lilipunies, are menaced by a creature called the Blop.

videos.title: Two Is Company — a Million Is a Little Crowded
videos.overview: Reddy's dander is raised when he sees the Blop picking on the Lilipunies.

videos.title: Big Bop for a Big Flop
videos.overview: Reddy fights back against the Blop, who takes Ruff captive.

videos.title: Things Get Tough for Ruff — Sure 'Nuff
videos.overview: Reddy searches the Blop's cave for Ruff.

videos.title: Whap — Caught in a Trap by a Sap
videos.overview: The Lilipunies help Reddy construct a spider web with which the catch the Blop.

videos.title: Spin, Spin a Web to Catch a Blop In
videos.overview: The boys beat a hasty retreat to their rocket.

videos.title: Have Blop, Will Travel
videos.overview: After the Blop gets away in the boys' rocket, the Lilipunies come up with a mode of transportation for Ruff and Reddy to return to Earth.
